title: Merck KGaA's Pimjetmi wins FDA approval in rare tumor disorder
summary:
Merck KGaA just secured an FDA approval for its new once-daily oral colony-stimulating factor-1 receptor (CSF-1R) inhibitor, adding to a growing list of regulatory checkmarks around the globe. 

The agency has approved pimicotinib, under the commercial moniker Pimjetmi, to treat symptomatic tenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT), a rare and non-cancerous, locally aggressive tumor that grows in or around the lining of the joints.
